schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
schemes.description: A special micro-credit facility for street vendors, with application and status services provided through the official portal.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
mandatory_requirements: Applicable State/Union Territory and local vendor-status conditions must be verified.
application_method: Online application through the PM SVANidhi portal
schemes.notes: The portal states that availability depends on States/UTs with notified rules and scheme under the Street Vendors Act; no further mandatory condition is inferred here.
